_comment: The player-facing half of resonance gear. Route (all via the gear_loop_start fixture -- see its own comment for why a dedicated fixture replaces a natural gold grind): (1) open the panel with the full 19-item catalog carried -- ui_inventory_shown now carries resonance{used,capacity}; screenshot the top AND the cursor-scrolled-to-bottom of the list (the full-pack scroll/clip proof, ScrollContainer + the new ensure_control_visible follow). (2) equip copper_luck_band (resonance 0) into accessory_1 -- POSITIVE proof of the new accessory slot rows + the generic equip-flow fix (Game.sim.equipped keys accessories by real slot name, not the 'accessory' kind). (3) equip hedge_ward_charm (resonance 1) into accessory_2 -- resonance_used climbs to 1/2; screenshot: accessory rows + Resonance header + this card's own generated 'Resonance 1' line + its new Lore line, all in one panel (the brief's required shot). (4) attempt stonescale_talisman (resonance 2): 1+2=3 > capacity 2 -- CAPACITY REFUSAL negative: toast (RATIFIED copy, 2026-07-07 HANDOFF item 1 -- the vibration line, canon-truest to Dissonance's warning sign) + equipped.accessory_3 stays empty (state unchanged) + item_equipped absent; screenshot the in-panel refusal echo (the toast layer draws BEHIND this panel -- see inventory.gd's _status_label). (5) re-confirm on the now-equipped copper_luck_band -- proves the equip/unequip TOGGLE now genuinely works for accessories (a pre-G3 bug silently no-op'd this). (6) confirm on field_whetstone (kind 'tool', not equippable) -- the panel's own neutral toast, proving tool items still get feedback instead of a silent no-op.

steps._comment: == (1) full pack open ==. ui_inventory_shown gains resonance{used,capacity} -- both pre-equipped items (rusty_sword, leather_jerkin) are resonance 0, so used starts at 0. 2026-07-08 hotfix: cursor_scroll:0 is the on-open first-row-visible proof -- row 0 (cursor start) must land at the TOP of the scroll, not scrolled past with no cursor mark on screen (the playtest-caught bug).

steps._comment: Cursor wraps to the LAST item (fishers_handline, index 18) -- the full-pack scroll/clip check: `_scroll.ensure_control_visible` should keep the selected row on-screen even though the ScrollContainer's own mouse_filter is IGNORE (no wheel input wired).
steps.name: move_down

steps._comment: == (2) equip copper_luck_band (index 10, resonance 0) -- POSITIVE accessory equip ==. Cursor at 18, up 8 -> index 10.
steps.name: move_up

steps._comment: == (4) CAPACITY REFUSAL negative ==. stonescale_talisman (index 14, resonance 2): 1 (already equipped) + 2 = 3 > capacity 2. Cursor at 11, down 3 -> index 14. The ratified vibration-line toast text; equipped.accessory_3 must stay empty and no item_equipped fires.
steps.name: move_down

payload_contains.text: It buzzes once against the others, like a wasp against glass, and will not settle.

steps._comment: == (5) unequip toggle proof ==. Re-select copper_luck_band (cursor at 14, up 4 -> index 10, still equipped in accessory_1) and confirm again -- pre-G3 this silently no-op'd (equip() called again instead of unequip(), refused by G1's own duplicate-slot guard with no toast at all).
